blocks.head: alt The user is not near any device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user has a stored message M
alt Any user can request reset without credentials or being nearby

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : Key , ...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceA | ('key' : Key , ...) > $ deviceA 'sendMessage' UserX | (encrypt(randomStr('R', N), Key)) .

eq < UserX | ('storedMessage' : nils , ..) > $ deviceA 'sendMessage' UserX | (Message) 
= < UserX | ('storedMessage' : Message , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('storedMessage' : OldMessage , ..) > $ deviceA 'sendMessage' UserX | (Message) 
= < UserX | ('storedMessage' : OldMessage , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('storedMessage' : encrypt(FreshR, Key) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : Owners , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; encrypt(FreshR, Key)) 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('storedMessage' : encrypt(randomStr('R', N), Key) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ....) , .....) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < UserX | ('storedMessage' : encrypt(FreshR, Key) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceA ; encrypt(FreshR, Key)) 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < UserX | ('storedMessage' : encrypt(randomStr('R', N), Key) , ...) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('key' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ....) , .....) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | (deviceA) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owners' : (UserX : (nils) , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
